comparison_basis.effort_definition: Git additions/deletions and changed files from each prior layer
comparison_basis.equivalent_scenario: tenant-scoped structured fake-provider call with explicit catalog, pre-call reservation, deterministic route, normalized usage/cost settlement, no network, and no production effect

custom_comparison.layer5_tradeoff: Official SDKs remove provider wire code but framework Layer 4 adds application controls rather than reducing them; it uses Temporal instead of the custom Redis worker runtime
custom_comparison.runtime_comparison_status: Equivalent network-free fake gateway scenarios ran on the same machine; figures are local implementation latency, not provider or distributed throughput
custom_comparison.temporal_tradeoff: Temporal removes scheduler, timers, signal history, retry/backoff, and crash recovery code but adds a second operational control plane

equivalent_gateway_benchmark.limitations: Different internal sync/async APIs; no PostgreSQL, Temporal, Redis, provider network, serialization, or process boundary was included

framework_code_removed: parallel fan-out and deterministic join engine
activity retry/backoff and worker crash recovery
OpenAI and Anthropic wire protocol and SDK exception transport

lock_in_and_escape.fastapi: typed request/response models at the delivery adapter
lock_in_and_escape.psycopg_postgresql: repository ports plus application-owned SQL migrations
lock_in_and_escape.pyjwt: AuthenticatorPort plus standard OIDC/JWT claims and JWK documents
lock_in_and_escape.temporal: opaque typed payloads plus application outbox, ActivityOperations, and application-owned ledger/projections

remaining_custom_controls: issuer registry and bounded JWKS rotation policy
immutable RBAC, purpose, risk, and policy evaluation
forced RLS schema and transaction tenant context
API anti-enumeration and readiness failure policy
event envelope and dual integrity chains
projection rebuild and redacted cursor API
tenant model policy/catalog and price versions
model routing, fallback, circuit, rate and concurrency policy
immutable provider call and ambiguous-billing facts
strict structured output, tools and citation controls
